subject: Post-call: VeritaPay acceptance criteria, evidence playbook, and retention clarifications
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lina Costa <lina.costa@veritapay.com>; Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@veritapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 18:15:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap + evidence playbook (next steps)

Hi Lina / Tom —

Thanks for a productive discussion today. Below is a concise recap of the pain points you shared, our acceptance criteria framing, and the specific evidence/artifacts we'll commit to deliver for your security review. I included owners and due-dates so we can keep this moving toward procurement.

Top takeaways (pain & impact)
- Primary concern: audit log fidelity and retention windows — you need per-request logs for user activity and admin actions retained for 12 months with exportability to your S3.
- Secondary: proof that customer data is logically isolated; you want DPA wording around data access and deletion triggers.
- Tertiary: pen test results and remediation history for any critical/high findings (last 24 months).

Goals we agreed:
- Provide a package of artifacts that maps to your internal acceptance checklist within 7 business days.
- Confirm any DPA/contract exceptions before legal review.
- Outline a retention implementation plan for audit logs (S3 lifecycle + encrypted archival).

Who will do what (owners / dates)
- Soojin (me): consolidate artifact index and share link to a read-only Drive folder — ETA: 2026-11-30 EOD.
- Karthik: pull engineer-verified descriptions for audit log schema, per-route logging capability, and KV cache retention behavior (and how that affects customer log correlation) — ETA: 2026-12-02.
- Grace: draft a targeted DPA amendment snippet and note any recommended contractual language on data deletion triggers — ETA: 2026-12-03.

Requested artifacts (what we'll provide)
1) SOC 2 scope summary + mapping (control-to-evidence) — stub: SOC2-scoping-matrix.xlsx [attachment]
2) Audit log export sample + schema definition and S3 lifecycle proposal — will include retention TTLs and encryption details.
3) Pen test summary (redacted) + remediation timeline — redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf [attachment].
4) Short note on runtime behavior affecting forensics: KV cache TTLs, prefix caching, and whether these create gaps in reconstructed sessions.
5) DPA amendment language proposal (one-page).

Clarifying Qs we noted for your InfoSec team:
- Is a 12-month retention (hot+warm storage) sufficient, or do you require cold-archival beyond 12 months?
- Are you able to accept redacted pen test reports (no customer-specific IPs), or do you need full attachments under an NDA?

Attachments: SOC2-scoping-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), auditlog-retention-proposal.md (md)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bVeritaPlaybook (read-only link will be live when I upload)

If this looks right, I'll upload the artifacts and ping you when the Drive folder is populated. Happy to jump on a short follow-up with engineering if you want a deep-dive into logging semantics.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173
[attachment: SOC2-scoping-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Lina Costa <lina.costa@veritapay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@veritapay.com>, security@veritapay.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + evidence playbook (next steps)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what our InfoSec and Legal expect. A couple quick clarifications from our side before you upload: 

1) Retention: 12 months is the baseline we require for operational logs (hot + warm). We may ask for 24 months for certain regulatory reporting later — please note it in the playbook as an optional extended tier we might enable.
2) Pen test artifacts: full reports are ideal but must be shared under an NDA. We can put a short NDA in place if that makes sharing easier.
3) DPA: legal will want explicit deletion triggers tied to customer termination and a data-scope diagram showing what Redwood stores versus transient cache contents.

A couple asks for your engineers: can you provide a sample log entry (fake PII removed) that shows the fields you capture (timestamp, request_id, actor_id, route, payload_hash, response_code)? That helps our devs map our audit tooling.

We'll plan internal review as soon as we see the Drive folder. If you can get the SOC2 mapping + export sample by Tuesday (12/1), we can aim to move to a procurement call the following week.

Best,
Lina

--
Lina Costa
Head of Platform Security | VeritaPay
lina.costa@veritapay.com
[signature removed]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Lina Costa <lina.costa@veritapay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + evidence playbook (next steps)

Lina — quick technical replies inline below and a note on artifacts we'll attach.

- Sample log schema: I'll include a redacted JSON sample in the Drive. Example fields: timestamp, request_id, customer_id, route, model_version, actor_role, action_type, response_code, token_count, payload_hash.

- KV cache & session forensics: our KV cache is per-model-variant and TTL-driven. For long-running sessions we persist a minimal session index (request_id -> cache_keys) that allows reconstructing sequences; however, raw ephemeral token buffers are not persisted beyond session. I'll document the exact TTLs and how they map to your retention needs.

- Export workflow: we support daily export of server-side audit logs to a customer-tagged S3 bucket (encrypted, SSE-KMS). Lifecycle policy recommended: 90 days hot, 275 days warm, then archive to Glacier/Deep for extended retention if requested.

I'll upload: redwood-auditlog-sample.json (redacted), auditlog-retention-proposal.md, redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf (redacted). ETA: 2026-12-02 (but SOC2 matrix from Soojin will be helpful earlier).

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Staff Engineer, Runtime & Reliability | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lina Costa <lina.costa@veritapay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + evidence playbook (next steps)

Perfect — thanks Lina and Karthik.

Actions I will take now:
- Upload the Drive folder tonight with the SOC2 matrix, a placeholder audit log sample, and the DPA amendment draft. Link will be the same Drive URL in my previous note; I'll notify you when it's live.
- I'll open an NDA template request in DocuSign for the pen test full report; Lina, if you confirm NDA ok, I'll route to Legal.

Next internal sync: I'll run a 20-minute alignment call with Karthik + Grace on 2026-12-02 to finalize the artifacts before the VeritaPay procurement sync. I'll send a calendar invite; please accept if available.

Thanks again — will follow up when the folder is ready.

Best,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
